name: Indonesia
prevalence_note: OJK (Indonesia Anti-Scam Centre / Satgas PASTI), DJP Pajak & Komdigi 2025-2026: courier package (`cek resi apk`) and digital wedding invite (`undangan apk`) malware, fake bank Rp150.000 monthly transaction-fee hike notices, OJK/Coretax tax impersonation demanding OTP or 'rekening aman', and giveaway 'biaya admin' scams dominate.
cross_border_note: Cross-border alert: +62 numbers calling foreign SIMs (especially TW, JP, KR, HK) are frequently spoofed VoIP routes used by cross-border fraud rings, while domestic Indonesian victims receive WhatsApp calls/files from disposable +62 and foreign virtual numbers.

scams.name: Penipuan Bank / OJK / Pajak Coretax（OTP・APK・Rekening Aman）
scams.name_en: Fake Indonesian bank, OJK or DJP Coretax officer demanding OTP, APK install or safe account
scams.signals_en: Impersonates bank security, OJK, or DJP Coretax claiming mandatory NIK-NPWP tax synchronization or suspicious activity; asks for OTP, WhatsApp `.apk` tax-app install, screen sharing, or transfer to `rekening aman`.
scams.legit_en: DJP Pajak, OJK, and Indonesian banks direct users strictly to official `.go.id` portals or branch counters and never send `.apk` files on WhatsApp or request OTPs.
bait_tactics: Berpura-pura sinyal HP lemah dan aplikasi sedang loading lama, minta dijelaskan pelan-pelan dari awal
Pura-pura mencari kacamata baca sambil bertanya detail kantor pelayanan pajak mana yang menangani
Berpura-pura lupa berkas NPWP dan sedang membongkar map dokumen lama di lemari

scams.name: Penipuan Kurir Paket (Cek Resi APK) & Undangan Digital APK
scams.name_en: Fake parcel courier 'cek resi.apk' or digital wedding invitation 'undangan.apk' SMS-stealing scam
scams.signals_en: Caller or WhatsApp sender poses as an express courier or acquaintance sending a disguised `.apk` file (`Lihat Foto Paket / Cek Resi.apk` or `Surat Undangan Pernikahan.apk`) and calls to urge opening it so malware can intercept mobile-banking SMS OTPs.
scams.legit_en: Real Indonesian couriers send plain JPEG photos or official tracking numbers verifiable on courier apps and never ask recipients to install `.apk` files.
bait_tactics: Katakan HP yang dipakai sekarang adalah ponsel jadul tanpa WhatsApp dan minta paketnya ditaruh di pos satpam saja
Tanyakan dari toko mana paket dikirim karena bulan ini sama sekali tidak belanja online

scams.name: Penipuan Perubahan Tarif Transaksi Bank Rp150.000 per Bulan
scams.name_en: Fake bank notice claiming transfer fees are changing to Rp150.000/month to steal OTPs and PINs
scams.signals_en: Impersonates BRI, BCA, Mandiri, or BNI customer care announcing that interbank transfer fees are switching from per-transaction to a flat Rp150.000 monthly debit unless the customer fills a cancellation link or reads out their OTP and PIN.
scams.legit_en: Indonesian banks publish fee schedules only on official websites/apps and never charge automatic Rp150.000 monthly upgrades or ask for PINs/OTPs to 'cancel' a tariff.
bait_tactics: Katakan saldo tabungan di rekening itu memang kosong jadi tidak masalah kalau mau dipotong biaya bulanan
Bilang akan mampir langsung ke kantor cabang bank dekat pasar besok pagi untuk menanyakan surat tersebut

scams.name: Penipuan Undian Hadiah（Biaya Admin / Pajak Pemenang）
scams.name_en: Indonesian prize/giveaway scam demanding upfront admin or winner tax fee
scams.signals_en: Congratulates victim on winning a bank, telecom, or e-commerce giveaway and demands upfront transfer of `biaya admin`, winner tax, or OTP before releasing the prize.
scams.legit_en: Official Indonesian bank and brand prize draws never demand upfront transfers to personal accounts or OTP codes to claim winnings.
bait_tactics: Berpura-pura senang menang hadiah, tanya warna hadiahnya dan minta biaya admin dipotong langsung dari uang hadiahnya saja
Minta alamat kantor pusat penyelenggara undian agar bisa datang mengambil hadiah secara langsung
